items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I had an engagement in Las Vegas after that, which I'd already signed, and there again I was going to take Willy up... So Willy's last work was with you. Yeah.

ctx.x: Well, Willy was passing and so was Juan, and they didn't show. And of course Joe Comfort played there and he didn't show either, you know. Joe played there with me. That was all right. Which was so ridiculous, you know.
